title: Open and closed extension preserve stratified finite scalar models
statement: Let $T$ be a Noetherian scheme, $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ an open immersion, and $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ its complementary closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $\Lambda$ be an admissible condensed coefficient ring of [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients], and use $R_V=\Lambda_V$ with its Cartesian coefficient identifications. For finite constant scalar-model constructibility [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the exact module functors $j_!$ and $i_*$ take constructible sheaves on $U$ and $Z$, respectively, to constructible sheaves on $T$. An adapted finite stratification on the source, viewed in $T$ and supplemented by the complementary locus, is adapted to the extension: the old local models are retained, and the additional locus has zero model.

source.place: paragraph (3), constructibility of immersion extensions; expanded directly on strata

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-noetherian-complementary-stratifications] to obtain Noetherian and qcqs source schemes, quasi-compactness of the open immersion, and both extended finite locally closed stratifications with constructible strata. Adjoin their constructibility proofs without changing any domain or map. Their dependent scheme/map equalities identify the reindexed domains and maps with the original composites followed by the given complementary scheme. Empty strata are retained.

For an arbitrary commutative condensed ring, apply [lem-sf-ring-sheaf-closed-localization] to its pulled-back ring object on T. The linear closed direct image is exact and has invertible counit, hence is fully faithful. Scalar restriction along the coefficient isomorphism is an exact equivalence. The comapPullbackHomCompIso of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] identifies its composite with the actual closed direct image, giving exactness and full faithfulness; the actual adjunction counit is therefore invertible. The open extension is exact by [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]; the fully faithful abelian extension of [lem-sfb-finite-extension-by-zero-fully-faithful] linearizes to a fully faithful module extension, and scalar equivalence gives an invertible adjunction unit. Use [lem-sfb-internal-open-extension-disjoint-vanishing] for the closed restriction of open extension. For the other cross restriction, [lem-sfb-proetale-open-disjoint-direct-image] says that the underlying abelian sheaf is open restriction of closed direct image, which is zero on disjoint supports, and the module forgetful functor reflects zero objects.

Implement the scalar-model argument directly from [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. For each old stratum, the pullback-composition isomorphism of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback], followed by the same-side restriction isomorphism of step 2, identifies its extended restriction with its original restriction. Use the already proved coefficient-generic private helper ContinuousRingUniverse.model_of_iso from the module of [lem-sfb-integral-continuous-cokernel-local-model] to transport this local model: it pulls the isomorphism through every member of the original cover and composes with its original model. The cover, scalar module and finite presentation are unchanged. Only this helper is used, not the integral cokernel theorem or its proof dependencies. On the complementary stratum use the identity cover and scalar module zero, which is finitely presented. Pullback of zero is zero. Prove reindexing of an arbitrary scheme/map property along the dependent-pair equalities of step 1, then instantiate it with the local-model predicate. Reindex the stratification by Option of the original finite index set, and obtain the required Over-isomorphisms from the same equalities. On qcqs schemes constructibility is existence of such an adapted stratification. Apply the argument to each source constructibility witness, then specialize the arbitrary condensed coefficient to every coefficient in the theorem.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (3); direct internal ring-sheaf localization and scalar equivalence, followed by the existing Noetherian complementary stratifications and transport of each original local model along pullback composition; reuse the existing coefficient-generic model_of_iso helper instead of duplicating local-model isomorphism transport
